documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited reported its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, alongside operational and strategic highlights. Management noted significant year-on-year growth in revenue, EBITDA, and net profit, supported by expanding value-added product shares and the advance gold model. The company also announced leadership appointments, strategic acquisitions, and a shift in promoter compensation policy to dividends only starting FY27. Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited achieved consolidated revenue of INR 2,013 crores for Q1 FY27, marking a 78% year-on-year growth. Consolidated gross margin reached 9.3%, while operating PAT crossed INR 100 crores for the first time.

guidance.claim: Sky Gold has maintained its FY27 revenue target of INR 8,100 crores.
guidance.quote: Our current FY27 revenue target of INR8,100 crores is meaningfully higher than the outlook we had communicated 9 months ago.

guidance.claim: The company targets revenues between INR 18,000 crores and INR 19,000 crores by FY30.
guidance.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

guidance.claim: The company expects an overall PAT margin close to 5%.
guidance.quote: And our overall PAT margin will be close to 5%.

guidance.claim: Revenue for FY27 is projected at approximately Rs. 8,100 crore.
The EBITDA margin for FY27 is expected to be in the range of ~7.0-7.5%.
guidance.quote: EBITDA margin expected in the range of ~7.0-7.5%

guidance.claim: The PAT margin for FY27 is guided at 4.5% - 4.75%.
By FY30, revenue is expected to be around Rs. 18,000 to 19,000 crore.

demand_outlook.claim: The share of non-22 KT jewelry increased to 14% in Q1 FY27 due to consumer preference shift towards lower Karatage jewelry.
demand_outlook.quote: First, the share of non-22 KT jewelry has increased from 10.5%in Q4FY26 to 14% in Q1 FY27 due to structural shift in customer preference towards lower Karatage jewelry.

demand_outlook.claim: Natural diamonds currently account for approximately 2% of total business.
demand_outlook.quote: Further, natural diamonds currently contribute approximately 2% of our overall business, presenting significant headroom for future growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Participation in a London expo built a prospective order pipeline of INR 30 crores to INR 45 crores across U.K. and European markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The response was highly encouraging, resulting in strong initial interest and helping us to build a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR30 crores to INR45 crores across the U.K. and European markets.

capex_expansion.claim: Any future facility expansion post-2028 will follow a leased model.
capex_expansion.quote: And post that, we may look at a new facility, but that we will continue on the leased model, and capex will not be very big.

capex_expansion.claim: Future capex after 2028 is expected to be between INR 80 crores and INR 100 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: It will be close to INR80 crores to INR100 crores, which will be just 20% to 25% of the PAT that we will generate at that point of time, since we have already built a world-class facility and we have already invested in the capacity and infrastructure.

capex_expansion.claim: Manufacturing footprint expanded to 1,35,000 sq. ft.
capex_expansion.quote: Manufacturing footprint expanded to 1,35,000 sq. ft.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross margin improved by 27 basis points quarter-on-quarter to 9.3% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 versus 9.1% in Q4 FY26, an improvement of 27 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 reached INR 157 crores with a margin of 7.8%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased to INR157 crores, to 7.8% for the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly operating PAT exceeded INR 100 crores for the first time.
margins_costs.quote: Operating PAT for the quarter crossed the INR100 crores mark for the first time.

margins_costs.claim: Value-Added share of business surged from <10% in FY23 to ~50-55% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Value-Added share of business has surged from <10% in FY23 to ~50-55% in FY26, serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.

margins_costs.claim: Gold loss was reduced from 1.5% to a lean 0.5% through the implementation of an ERP.
margins_costs.quote: We have implemented an ERP to monitor operational KPI’s, this has led to reduction of gold loss from 1.5% to a lean 0.5%.

orders_capacity.claim: The manufacturing footprint has expanded to 1,50,000 square feet.
orders_capacity.quote: Manufacturing footprint expanded to 1,50,000 sq. ft.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization stands at approximately 55% to 57%.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, the capacity utilization is close to 55%- 57%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's total production capacity is 1.2 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: So, 1.2 tons is our capacity to produce, and we are 60% approx utilization in the last quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, and all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.
capital_allocation.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

capital_allocation.claim: Net working capital cycle stood at approximately 60 days at the end of the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: As a result, we are closing this quarter at approximately 60 days of our net working capital cycle.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash flow turned positive at approximately INR 30 crores in Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: Our cash flows from operations turned positive at close to INR30 crores in Q1 FY27 compared to negative operating cash flows till the end of '26.

capital_allocation.claim: Debt reduction and balance sheet strengthening remain the top capital allocation priority.
capital_allocation.quote: Our first priority will always be debt reduction and balance sheet strengthening.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt level at the end of the quarter was INR 540 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Net debt level for this quarter is INR540 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoters are shifting to a zero-salary compensation model starting FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, with all promoter payouts solely through dividends.
capital_allocation.quote: promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company experienced an incident involving an amount of INR 10.7 crores, of which legal efforts are ongoing to maximize recovery.
risks_headwinds.quote: So, out of that, INR10.7 crores was the total amount involved, but such incidents have unfortunately become increasingly prevalent across many organizations which are listed on the BSE and NSE.

risks_headwinds.claim: Gold price volatility created margin pressures across retailers and manufacturers in the jewelry sector.
risks_headwinds.quote: In recent quarters, heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across various retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will not draw salaries from FY27 onwards, receiving payouts solely through dividends.
management_commitments.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: Sky Gold aims to achieve its FY27 revenue target of INR 8,100 crores.
management_commitments.quote: Our current FY27 revenue target of INR8,100 crores is meaningfully higher than the outlook we had communicated 9 months ago.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to maintain an average of 15% sales on the Advance Gold model in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: I am pleased to share that we have achieved 17% sales on the Advance Gold model, significantly ahead of our expectation of 15% of the Advance Gold model for FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Beginning FY27, promoter compensation will be entirely linked to zero-salary and dividend payouts from operating cash flow.
management_commitments.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
